# P05 adjudicated fixtures

`P05-development-cases.yaml` contains the owner-adjudicated development oracle.
`P05-development-facts.yaml` contains executable synthetic B/D facts for those
26 cases. `P05-heldout-oracle.yaml` keeps the seven heldout expectations outside
the heldout input directory.

These fixtures evaluate candidate semantics only. They do not promote a rule,
approve a support edge, or provide production evidence.
